emailForwarding.subtitle: Configure email forwarding recipients for batbern.ch addresses.

venueCoordination.title: Venue & Catering Contacts
venueCoordination.subtitle: These contacts receive the offerte and timetable emails sent from the Event Detail Venue tab. They are the same across every event — define them once here.
venueCoordination.coordinatorHelp: The organizer username (e.g. nissim.buchs) whose email address will appear as Reply-To on every venue/catering message. Replies from the recipient go straight to them.
